{{ModBox}}
'''Primed Chamber''' is a [[:Category:Sniper Mods|sniper rifle mod]] that increases the [[damage]] from the first shot fired from a fresh magazine.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mods#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! Effect
! [[Mods#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || +25% || 4
|-
| 1 || +50% || 5
|-
| 2 || +75% || 6
|-
| 3 || +100% || 7
|}

==Acquisition==
*This mod can be purchased '''unranked''' from [[Baro Ki'Teer]] for {{dc|2,995}} and {{cc|1,000,000}}. Note however that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and may not have this item available every time.

===Historical===
*This was originally distributed to the top 100 ranked players in the [[Informant Event]], based on the number of [[Informer]] kills.
*For a short time after {{ver|10.6}} it could have been acquired via transmutation<ref>{{Ref|title=Psa: Unintended Mod/aura Inclusion|first=Rebecca|last=Ford|year=2013|month=10|day=31|publisher=Warframe Forums|url=https://forums.warframe.com/index.php?/topic/126550-psa-unintended-modaura-inclusion/|access-date=2022-06-13|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220613164638/https://forums.warframe.com/topic/126550-psa-unintended-modaura-inclusion/|archive-date=2022-06-13}}</ref>. This was due to a bug where all mods (including unreleased ones) became obtainable through transmutation. This has since been fixed, but players who obtained the mod this way were allowed to keep it.
*During Devstream 17, 18, 43, 49, 59, 94, 107, 112, and 116 one lucky winner was given a Primed Chamber mod through random selection. Two winners were randomly selected during Devstream 121.
*A single Primed Chamber was given out as the first place reward for the [https://forums.warframe.com/index.php?/topic/393551-new-mirror-the-mod-contest/ Mirror the Mod Contest].
*A Primed Chamber was given out upon reaching $4,000.00 during the [https://www.warframe.com/news/fan-channel-charity-stream WarframeFanChannels Extra-Life] event in February 2017.
*The option of being given either a Primed Chamber or a Legendary Core was given by [DE]Sheldon at [[TennoCon/2017|TennoCon 2017]] to five people who caught MTG cards he threw out into the audience. He later signed these cards as proof of the prize.
*A Primed Chamber was given to an attendee of the TennoVIP 2018 in Cologne, Germany. The winner was selected randomly from a list of attendees by [DE]Rebecca and [DE]Megan.
*Two Primed Chambers were given out during QuietteShy's Twitch stream via random selection on January 16, 2019.

==Notes==
*Despite its name, Primed Chamber is not related to [[Primed Mods]], and was in fact added to the game long before the first such mod. As a result, it is not the "Primed version" of {{M|Charged Chamber}}, and thus can be equipped alongside it.
*Primed Chamber is applied multiplicatively after all other modifiers from mods and abilities. 
**For example, a {{Weapon|Vectis}} with a max rank Primed Chamber, {{M|Serration}}, {{M|Cryo Rounds}}, {{M|Target Acquired}}, and {{M|Bane of Grineer}}, and a subsumed {{A|Eclipse}} with base Ability Strength, will deal {{Math|225 {{mul}} (1 + 1.0) {{mul}} (1 + 1.65) {{mul}} (1 + 0.90) {{mul}} (1 + 0.60) {{mul}} (1 + 0.30) {{mul}} (1 + 0.30)|round=1|t=y}} headshot damage.
*The damage bonus applies to all [[Multishot]] hits and to [[Status Damage]].
*Stacks additively with {{M|Charged Chamber}} for up to 140% bonus damage.
*If used with [[Ammo Efficiency]] bonuses, Primed Chamber will provide bonus damage to a shot as long as the magazine counter is at <math>\text{Max Magazine} - 1</math> <u>after</u> a shot is fired.
**For example, a {{Weapon|Vulkar}} with {{A|Energized Munitions}} will have the 4th, 5th, 6th, and 7th shots buffed by Primed Chamber, since the magazine counter is at {{Math|6 - 1|bf=y}} during those shots.
**Wait to trigger any 100% ammo efficiency effects until a single shot has been consumed from the magazine, since the buff doesn't apply if the mag remains completely full after the shot.

==Tips==
*This mod goes particularly well with the {{Weapon|Vectis}}. Its one-shot magazine ensures that the damage bonus applies to all shots fired.
**When combined with {{M|Depleted Reload}}, this also applies to the {{Weapon|Vectis Prime}}.

==Trivia==
*[DE]Rebecca has stated the following on the topic of people being upset over Primed Chamber being exclusive:

{{Quote|Ah, we did not say the Primed Chamber mod is Exclusive to the Drone weekend event, it was just the first time it was introduced. Sorry for the confusion there! I imagine it will appear again in future events.|[DE]Rebecca<ref>{{Ref|title=Ah, we did not say the Primed Chamber mod is Exclusive to the Drone weekend event, it was just the first time it was introduced.|first=Rebecca|last=Ford|year=2013|month=7|day=19|publisher=Warframe Forums|url=https://forums.warframe.com/topic/83159-so-i-guess-new-players-are-screwed-huh/?tab=comments#comment-907842|access-date=2022-06-13|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220613164450/https://forums.warframe.com/topic/83159-so-i-guess-new-players-are-screwed-huh/?tab=comments|archive-date=2022-06-13}}</ref>}}
*Due to the release of {{M|Charged Chamber}}, it seemed unlikely that Primed Chamber will be released as a drop however the possibility of Primed Chamber appearing in another event has been confirmed in [[Livestream 17]]. DE said they were going to have it as a [[The Gradivus Dilemma|Gradivus Dilemma]] reward, but "didn't get that far" and are looking for the next appropriate event to add it to.
**Since {{ver|27.1.1}}, the mod has been added to [[Baro Ki'Teer]]'s rotation with no prior notice.

==Acquisition==
Obtainable from the [[Arbitrations]] vendor in the {{Faction|Arbiters of Hexis}} room in [[Relay]]s for 20 {{Resource|Vitus Essence}}.

==Notes==
*The energy is rewarded even while [[:Category:Channeled_Abilities|channeled abilities]] are active.
*{{D|Electricity}} and {{D|Gas}} status effect can also trigger the energy gain, even if the direct weak point hit didn't kill the target.
*[[Punch Through]] kills activate the mod multiple times.

==Tips==
*Synergizes well with {{WF|Ivara}} and her {{A|Prowl}}, as the ability gives Ivara bonus damage to headshots while using energy over time. The sniper must be silent however to avoid breaking her invisibility when firing.
*Synergizes very well with {{WF|Cyte-09}} and his {{A|Neutralize}}. The ability grants Cyte-09 an Exalted sniper rifle that costs energy to fire. Even with '''100%''' Ability Efficiency, '''1''' weak point is more than enough to not just refund the energy cost but also give you a net positive of '''+5''' energy per weak point.
**[[Punch Through]] kills activate the mod multiple times, giving it a great synergy with {{A|Seek}}.
**{{A|Neutralize}} ricochet does '''not''' activate the mod multiple times, only the main bullet counts. However weak point kills from [[:Category:Extra-hit Buffs|Extra-hit Buffs]] (e.g. {{A|Resupply}}), and {{D|Electricity}} or {{D|Gas}} procs '''do''' activate it on ricochet.
***None of this works if ricochet hits a [[Weakpoint]] that is not a head.

==Acquisition==
This mod can be bought from [[Baro Ki'Teer]] for {{dc|300}} and {{cc|200,000}}.

==Notes==
*Cannot be used with {{M|Split Chamber}} or {{M|Galvanized Chamber}}.
*Cannot be equipped on:
**{{Weapon|Artemis Bow}} 
**{{Weapon|Attica}}
**{{Weapon|Kuva Bramma}}
**{{Weapon|Lenz}} ({{Weapon|Prisma Lenz|Prisma}})
**{{Weapon|Nagantaka}} ({{Weapon|Nagantaka Prime|Prime}})
**{{Weapon|Nataruk}}
**[[Nunchasa]]
**{{Weapon|Proboscis Cernos}}
**{{Weapon|Zhuge}} ({{Weapon|Zhuge Prime|Prime}})
*Added spread is not affected by bonuses that increase accuracy, such as {{M|Twitch}} or {{M|Guided Ordnance}}.
*Multishot allows for getting multiple stacks in one shot.
*Punch-through allows for getting multiple stacks in one shot.
*Subsequent hits refresh all stacks' duration.
*Stacks expire all at once after 2 seconds without a hit.
*{{WF|Mirage}}'s {{A|Hall of Mirrors}} clones do not benefit from this mod.

==Tips==
*Works well with the {{Weapon|Mutalist Cernos}} as damage dealt by the clouds refresh the mod's duration, allowing an even higher amount of procs to occur on targets.
*Works well with the {{Weapon|Cernos Prime}}, because each of the innate 3 arrows activate this mod, and the spread from low accuracy is only perpendicular to the spread of the 3 arrows. 
*Works well with the {{Weapon|Paris}} and {{Weapon|Dread}} [[Incarnon|incarnons]], because they can very easily generate all 4 stacks with a single shot due to their innate infinite punch through and large projectile sizes.
*Explosions from {{M|Thunderbolt}} satisfy the requirement to activate the mod, making it easier to keep the buff going.

==Trivia==
*Could unintentionally be acquired via [[transmutation]] upon release which was later patched server-side<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TgkA5CzaLSc&t=525 Prime Time #266]</ref>.
*This mod was added to [[Baro Ki'Teer]]'s inventory for the first time on the weekend of March 27, 2020.

They also have different interactions with Health orbs: **Primary fire's beam/projectiles '''and''' their AoE explosions will pick up orbs. **Secondary fire will also pick up orbs if: ***The speargun hits the orb directly, which will make the weapon return to the player immediately, as if their timer had expired when deployed. ***The Health orbs are within the {{Weapon|Scourge}}'s radial explosion, but '''not''' the {{Weapon|Ferrox}}'s AoE. *This mod will make projectiles stop when hitting Health orbs, potentially wasting ammo. This can vary with hitscan weapons. **Weapons with [[Multishot]] can pick up Health orbs with just a single projectile. *Health orbs picked up this way will trigger on-Health-pickup effects, like {{Arcane|Arcane Pulse}}, {{M|Health Conversion}} and {{M|Equilibrium}}. **{{M|Equilibrium}} (including {{WF|Equinox}}'s passive) '''does not''' scale off of the increased health gained. ***Bonus does affect {{M|Equilibrium}}'s conversion on Health Orbs from dispensers in [[Arena]] gamemodes. *Increased Health Orb Effectiveness is additive with similar increases from {{Resource|Amber Archon Shard}} and {{M|Restorative Bond}}, but multiplicative with {{WF|Dagath}}'s Passive. *Works across the material and [[Rift Plane|Rift]] planes. ==Tips== *Somewhat useful when paired with abilities that increase the chances of Health orbs dropping, like {{WF|Nezha}}'s {{A|Blazing Chakram}} or {{WF|Nekros}}' {{A|Desecrate}}. *Most useful for healing companions in conjunction with mods such as {{M|Synth Deconstruct}} as they take the multiplied value of the orb as opposed to the base, and constant upkeep of {{M|Synth Fiber}}.  *Use of the mod with weapons such as, or similar to, {{Weapon|Komorex}} allows for the collection of orbs without the need of precision allowing constant regeneration of a sentinel or viable upkeep of {{M|Health Conversion}} on frames that produce less health orbs or even no health orbs on average than frames mentioned above.  ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|27.5.3}} *Fixed ability to equip the Mending Shot Mod on the Shedu. Mending Shot is a Rifle (no AOE) Mod. {{ver|27.3}} *Introduced. }} ==See Also== *{{M|Energizing Shot}}, the secondary equivalent for [[Pickups#Energy|Energy Orbs]]. {{PrimaryMods}} [[es:Disparo reparador]] [[fr:Tir Réparateur]] [[ru:Лечебный Выстрел]] [[Category:Update 27]] [[Category:Exilus Weapon Mods]] [[Category:Non-AoE Rifle Mods]] [[uk:Зцілювальний постріл]] [[Category:Self-Revive Mechanics]]
